title: Fixture Placement Schema
description: Fixture placement in a room: device ID, position, orientation, footprint/outline, and target drainage point.

placementId.description: Stable UUID for this placement instance. Unique per fixture instance in a room.

roomId.description: Reference to the room measurement (roomId in measurement schema).

productId.description: Reference to the product definition (productId in product schema).

position.description: Center/anchor point of the fixture in 3D room coordinates. Z=0 is finished floor.

orientation.description: Fixture orientation. Rotation is counterclockwise when viewed from above (Z axis).

footprint.description: Occupied area / footprint of the fixture on the finished floor plane.

targetDrainagePoint.description: Reference to the drain this fixture connects to (drainId in measurement schema). Required when the fixture requires drainage.

Point3D.description: A 3D point. X = horizontal (increasing right), Y = depth (increasing inward), Z = height (increasing upward). Unit: mm (integer).

z.description: Z coordinate in millimeters. 0 = finished floor level.

rotationZ.description: Rotation around Z axis in degrees. Positive = counterclockwise when viewed from above. Range: [0, 360).

facing.description: Cardinal direction the fixture front faces. Redundant with rotationZ but provides human-readable intent.

Footprint.description: Occupied area of the fixture on the finished floor plane.

width.description: Bounding width (X axis) in mm. For circular, this is the diameter.

depth.description: Bounding depth (Y axis) in mm. For circular, this is the diameter (same as width).

vertices.description: Polygon vertices defining the fixture outline, relative to position. Required when type=polygonal. Counterclockwise order.

Point2DRel.description: A 2D point relative to the fixture's position anchor.
